visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video uses a split-screen format. In the top panel, seven women with long hair are seated on the edge of an indoor pool with their backs to the camera, wearing oversized black t-shirts. The bottom panel shows a wider 'behind the scenes' perspective of the same scene, including a cameraman and lighting equipment on the right. Pokemon character stickers (Jigglypuff, Pikachu, Charmander, Squirtle) are overlaid between the two panels. (2) The women turn their heads toward the camera, smiling and waving with friendly expressions. They are in a well-lit indoor spa or pool area with large windows in the background showing a bright environment. (3) In a synchronized motion, all seven women lift the back of their black t-shirts simultaneously. This reveals their lower bodies, specifically wearing colorful underwear that features the faces of the same Pokemon characters shown in the stickers earlier. They appear to be laughing and celebrating the reveal while facing away or looking back playfully.

(2) Immediately following the 'One', there is a sharp burst of high-pitched cheering and laughter from multiple female voices, signaling a moment of collective excitement. (3) The electronic music continues its driving rhythm through the end of the clip, maintaining a high-energy and joyful atmosphere with bright synthesizer chords and steady percussion.

By utilizing a 'behind the scenes' motif and a synchronized countdown, it builds anticipation for the group's coordinated action of showing off their Pokemon-themed underwear, tapping into internet subculture and viral comedy trends.
